name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1898: The art server refuses anything outside the art directory with a prefix test, and on Windows a case difference makes that say no, so the traversal guard fails closed on his own pictures. It uses the same one path rule now: resolve both sides, ask the filesystem by inode, fall back to case normalisation, which is exactly as strict because normalising both sides identically cannot admit a path outside. And a correction I caught before shipping: I had written that the art directory was un-resolved and any symlink would 403 everything, then checked and found it realpath-d at its definition. A comment that invents the defect it fixes is the same lie as a wrong receipt.
